name: Prepare RAG document datasets and review quality with Apify

parameters.content:
## Prepare documents for RAG
1. Create an Apify account and API token. Create an n8n Header Auth credential with name `Authorization` and value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`. Select the same credential in all six HTTP request nodes: Start Apify report, Wait for same run, Read completion status, Read QA, Read manifest, Read chunk operations.
2. Run the default fictional demo. Inspect `review`; top-level handoff arrays remain empty. Platform usage may apply.
3. Edit Choose input for your authorized dataset. Non-demo completed reports cost US$0.50 plus usage; the run has a US$0.75 maximum charge setting.
[Actor and documentation](https://apify.com/millgrah/rag-knowledge-base-sync-qa)

## Completion, QA and destination acceptance
Starts one Actor run; a bounded GET waits for that same run. No POST retry or polling loop. If the wait expires, inspect the exact run ID before starting another paid report.
`COMPLETE` confirms report production, not clean QA. Rejected rows block the top-level handoff. Fictional demos and partial/incremental inputs are review-only. Only explicit complete snapshots with clean QA, an eligible manifest and the Actor approval contract can set `downstreamReady:true`. Older Actor outputs without that contract stay review-only.
`review` is for inspection. Consume the top-level arrays only after checking `downstreamReady`; review DELETE suggestions separately. There are no destination writes in this recipe.
The baseline candidate is not committed. Keep the previous baseline until the destination confirms all operations were accepted; `baseline.updated` and `baseline.commitAllowed` stay false here.
Full n8n runtime execution has not yet been verified; code-node fixture tests are separate.
